abstract: NETCONF via SSH subsystem mapping spec.

init_sequence: ssh-connection -> Open channel 'session' -> Invoke subsystem 'netconf' (SSHv2 ONLY)

chunked.abnf: Chunked-Message = 1*chunk end-of-chunks; chunk = LF '#' chunk-size LF chunk-data; end-of-chunks = LF '#' '#' LF

constraints.error_handling: Invalid size/decode_error => Terminate SSH channel immediately (buffer overrun protection)

eom_legacy.context: Fallback for :base:1.0 only. Vulnerable to payload injection if delimiter exists in native XML attributes/comments.

session_lifecycle.termination: Client sends <close-session> -> Server replies <rpc-reply><ok/></rpc-reply> -> Server closes SSH channel instantly (ignores subsequent mutations)

security.auth: Mutual identity verification mandatory prior to data/credential tx
security.crypto: Strong transport encryption required for confidentiality (sensitive configurations/keys)
security.firewall: TCP/830 defaults allow distinct filtering, but increases attack surface discovery. Alternative ports MUST be configurable.
security.mitigation: Chunked framing removes payload delimiter injection vector present in RFC 4742.

diff_4742: + Strict XML validity check for authenticated username
+ Distinct mapping definitions for SSH vs NETCONF layer entity roles
